title: a split gene converted to a database where the best descendant has no id
what: converted to an external database, the answer is first ranked as Ensembl genes (row I151); where Ensembl's history splits the gene and the best descendant has no id in the database the result is no_target with the genes, in the view `all` too, although other descendants of the split carry ids there
user_action: convert to Ensembl genes first, then each gene of the view `all` to the database
fixed_by: open: a question of the modest set on the tree `r2` (docs/modest.md)

title: an answer the truth's list of genes lacks: an LRG record
what: Ensembl's history gives the id no successor and idtrack bridges to an LRG record (Ensembl's core gene table holds it at the target release, its GTF does not), which describes the gene at that place; the truth reads the GTF as the list of genes, so the answer is judged not at the query's place
user_action: read `result.path.bridges`; ask for the Ensembl gene of the record
fixed_by: none (the truth: the GTF lists no LRG record)

title: no successor in Ensembl's history: a bridge through a shared id
what: an id Ensembl's history ends is carried through an external id or a name to a gene that does not overlap it (the bridges the package's own limitations state: no record of Ensembl states the gene a bridge reaches)
when: reason:^Ensembl has no successor; not at the query's place
